purpose: Test a temporal residual corrector after the snapshot corrector improved frames but worsened possession objects.
training: V21 cross-half predictions on outer training matches only; input161, local width48 TCN, zero-initialized residual head; final logits=log(base p)+delta. 1200 updates seed2033, 75% error-centered crops, segment-weighted CE, .05 same-label smoothness, .01 residual L2.
selection: Highest selection spellF1 with macro>=baseline-.002; freeze then evaluate selected only on fold2; adopt if both game means improve and macro>=baseline-.002.
limitation: Inner cross-half versus outer cross-match probability mismatch; historically seen development games, repeated selection not an unbiased final test.
